verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a business phone service that supports SMS, so automatic STOP/HELP keyword handling and opt-out suppression is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers keyword handling, opt-out management or suppression of opted-out contacts from future sends. Community posts mention texting, but only reliability and usability, not compliance handling.

support.subject: As a support leader, STOP and HELP keywords are handled automatically and opted-out contacts are suppressed from future sends
